purpose: Teach: 劣等/集権/旋回/発声/強大/果敢/残存/掟

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、社会的劣等感を抱える人の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper explored social inferiority complexes, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Gentle confirmation-seeking tone. Leaning forward slightly. Steady, professorial pace. The question of someone genuinely interested in the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中央集権体制の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the history of centralized state systems.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. No hesitation. Slight pride in the topic without overselling it. Even pace, grounded delivery. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦闘機の旋回戦術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined fighter jet tactical maneuvers in that piece, I recall.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, measured delivery. Gentle uncertainty in the recall — inviting her to correct or confirm. The tone of someone reconsidering something aloud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、声楽における発声法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I studied vocal techniques in classical singing.
lines.style: Polite, quiet correction. No edge. Patient explanation, as if clarifying a simple misunderstanding. Steady eye contact through the reply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 強大な国家を作り上げた指導者を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the paper on powerful leaders who built nations — that was quite striking.
lines.style: Appreciative note in the opening. Engaged tone, leaning in. Genuine warmth about the subject matter. Slight emphasis on 'striking' — real recognition, not empty praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、果敢な戦士の行動分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed the behavioral patterns of courageous warriors in difficult circumstances.
lines.style: Measured response. Slight expansion of what was actually written, delivered without presumption. Calm, specific. The tone of someone explaining their own work clearly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の残存兵力研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your research into remaining military forces during wartime — I found that particularly thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost quiet. Genuinely reconsidering the work as she speaks. A small pause before the compliment. Warm but not effusive. The tone of a teacher being honest about what moved her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、暴力組織の掟の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I actually focused on the codes and structures within organized crime networks.
lines.style: Quiet correction, delivered without frustration. Patient, as if this is the third time explaining it. Steady close. The tone of someone used to not being fully heard, but still clear in her answer.
